## A complete rewrite — tactical carry, forensics, storage, and a live admin dashboard

mbt_malisling 2.0.0 is a ground-up rewrite of the original weapon-on-back resource. The original work is **Gianmarco's (DarkSideofTheCode)**; this release rebuilds it on a modular architecture and adds a deep layer of carry, forensics and storage features — plus a live React admin dashboard, a switchable **Cinematic** UI skin, and a full `qb-inventory` bridge — all without touching combat balance.

### Carry & identity

- **Tactical Sling prop** with multiple variants and per-job assignment
- **Concealed Carry** — hide a weapon under clothing (clothing-aware, server-authoritative)
- **Low Ready** chest-carry stance
- **Weapon Condition HUD** (tier 1–5 pips) and **Weapon Safety Toggle**
- **Custom Weapon Name** (engraving) and **Showcase Poses**

### Interaction & social

- **Physical Weapon Handoff** — consent-driven, server-atomic transfer with rollback
- **Ammo Sharing**
- **Pat-down (LEO)** — job-gated, consent-based, with an audit webhook

### Forensics

- **Serial Number System** — every weapon is guaranteed a serial on safe transitions (never during fire)
- **Chain of Custody** — a per-serial ledger of who has held a weapon
- **Forensic Shell Casings** — examinable brass left at the scene

### Storage

- **Weapon Rack / Gun Locker** — fixed world racks and player-placeable racks from an item
- **Vehicle Trunk Weapon Rack**

### Handling & world

- Optional **hold-to-charge power throw** (the original forward throw stays the default)
- **Suppressor Heat Glow**, **Weapon Weight / Carry Penalty**, **Charge Weapon**, **No-Draw Zones**, **Vehicle Smart Hiding**, **Weapon Inspect** (with a vague-ammo mode)

### Interface

- Two switchable UI styles (live, from the dashboard): the default **Standard** overlays, and a new **Cinematic** skin — filmic weapon-moment reveals (holster, inspect) that anchor to the weapon in the world, plus a cohesive dark-glass theme with animated accents across every HUD, prompt and picker

### Admin & tooling

- A **live React admin dashboard** (`/mbt_malisling`) — toggle and tune every feature at runtime, persisted to the database
- A **live NUI Position Editor** — set sling positions per weapon type and per job, in-world
- Dev tuning commands: `/mbt_racktune`, `/mbt_trunktune`, `/mbt_propedit`
- A full **qb-inventory** bridge alongside `ox_inventory`
- Localization: **English, Italian, French**

### Changed

- Modular `core/` + `modules/` architecture
- Configuration split into `default.lua` (feature defaults, tuned live from the dashboard) and `config.lua` (server settings)
- License is now **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0**

### Requirements

- `ox_lib`, OneSync, and either **ox_inventory** or **qb-inventory**
- `oxmysql` is optional (enables persistence: placed racks, trunk, custody, saved positions) — without it the script runs DB-free

### Install

> **Upgrading from 1.x: replace the whole folder and do NOT keep your old `config.lua`.**
> It opens with `MBT = {}` and loads after `default.lua`, so keeping it wipes the new defaults and the script won't start. Feature tuning also moved out of `config.lua` into the dashboard — your 1.x settings won't carry over, so set them again in-game (they persist to the database from then on).

1. Download `mbt_malisling.zip` below and drop it into your server's `resources` folder.
2. In `server.cfg`: `ensure ox_lib`, then your inventory, then `ensure mbt_malisling` (after them).
3. Restart the server once so the sling convar applies cleanly.
4. Open `/mbt_malisling` in-game (admin) to configure.

See the [README](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling) for full details, including the qb-inventory notes.
